Create Room: 
Players can create Training Terrace rooms and become the Host, managing members and matches. Ownership can be transferred or automatically passed to the most popular member if the Host leaves. 

Formats: 
The Host can set the Challenge Mode: Free Mode or Management Mode. 
Free Mode: Players can freely select opponents or teams to issue Challenges or Targeted Duels. 
Management Mode: Players or Captains sign up, and the Host decides the match-ups. 
Victory Conditions: Best of 1, Best of 3, or Best of 5. 
Training Terrace supports 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 5v5 team battles. 

Popularity and Room Heat: 
Receiving gifts increases personal Popularity. More members, battles, and gifts increase Room Popularity. Both reset daily at 05:00.
